subject: world_language
concept: Handling a simple unplanned situation (asking for help, clarifying a misunderstanding) in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'cope with unplanned situations' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student role-plays a realistic scenario (lost item, confusion about instructions) and asks for help in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a clarifying phrase to the situation it would resolve
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short exchange handling a described unplanned situation

misconception_flags: responds to the unplanned situation with a memorized script unrelated to the actual problem

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
